description: Use when an integration or unit test mutates module-level state that outlives it, such as `await import('@/…')` for a side effect, a `bind*` or `set` call on an `export default new …` singleton, or an assignment to `process.env`, and the file has an ordering dependency — adding a case breaks a previously green sibling, an assertion passes only in one run order, or a test comment claims a precedence that nothing in the file pins.
